summary: Northern Virginia resident, MIT alumnus, technical background in programming and engineering, strong interest in computer science and technology, critical of corporate influence in politics, advocates for transparency and accountability in government and corporate practices, skeptical of mainstream climate science narratives, believes in the importance of individual responsibility and informed decision-making, values personal privacy and data security, engages in discussions about the implications of technology on society, supports the idea of self-education and critical thinking over blind acceptance of authority.
